articles.summary: US$4M gross proceeds to support potential M&A, working capital and corporate purposes after Real Messenger’s 5,714,284-unit offering closed June 9, 2026.
articles.title: Real Messenger Corporation Announces Closing of US$4.0 Million Public Offering

articles.summary: Real Messenger prices 5,714,284 units at $0.70, each bundling shares and warrants, for expected gross proceeds of $4.0M; closing is expected June 9, 2026.
articles.title: Real Messenger Corporation Announces Pricing of US$4.0 Million Public Offering
